_comment: Editorial content for MUGHALC, which is a listed security of another issuer rather than an operating company — see description and sourceNote. No image is attached: a security line owns no facility, and a photograph of the issuer's plant would misrepresent it as a separate business.
description: Mughal Iron & Steel Industries Ltd (C) is the PSX symbol for a separate class of shares of Mughal Iron & Steel Industries Limited, traded alongside the company's ordinary shares (MUGHAL). PSX publishes no separate company profile for the line; the issuer's business is described under MUGHAL.
sourceNote: PSX instrument listing for MUGHALC (dps.psx.com.pk/company/MUGHALC: symbol name and equity profile; no company profile published), read 2026-10-17.
